# Prevalence: winners against unawarded pages

<!-- generated by scripts/contrast-set.mjs from _prevalence.json; do not edit by hand -->

Which audit rules fire on the corpus's live pages and on a contrast group of unawarded pages (template demos and launches, listed in `_contrast-queue.md`), measured with `audit.mjs <url> --render` at desktop, tablet and phone. A rule far more common in the contrast group is a habit that separates; one equally common in both is the genre's, whatever its slop-scan row says. Measured pages: 0 winners, 1 unawarded. With groups this small, read a difference under about 25 points as noise. The contrast group leans to SaaS templates, so it says most about the template and category ruts.
